hints.title: Single Digit Feasibility
hints.text: If any single digit is strictly greater than k, it is impossible to partition the string.

hints.title: Greedy Extension Strategy
hints.text: Extend the current substring by appending digits as long as the numerical value does not exceed k.

hints.title: Cut Initiation
hints.text: As soon as appending the next digit causes the number to exceed k, commit the current substring and start a new substring.

hints.title: Greedy Substring Partitioning Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass greedy accumulation of substring numerical values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all partitioning split positions takes exponential O(2^n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that greedy longest valid prefix consumption produces minimum partition count.
